What if Assassin's Creed went to the future?

The Animus sends you forward instead of back, into a neon megacity owned by Abstergo. Your Leap of Faith now goes off a skyscraper and lands in a hover car instead of a haystack. Should Assassin's Creed ever leave history behind, or is the past the whole point?
